description: FREE. Look up city/region location codes in Germany, Austria and Switzerland (e.g. Rosenheim, Wien, Zürich). These codes work for google_serp, local_business, news_search, image_search and local_market_check; all other tools take country codes (2276, 2040, 2756).

country.description: Optional: restrict the search to Germany (DE), Austria (AT) or Switzerland (CH).

query.description: Part of the place name, at least 2 characters.

name: find_location
